Bug_Details:
Although Guice allows injecting final fields, doing so is disallowed because the injected value may not be visible to other threads. From the Guice wiki: Injecting final fields is not recommended because the injected value may not
be visible to other threads.
Bug_Explanation: To fix the compilation error, the unnecessary import 'com.google.inject.Inject' was removed and the @Inject annotation was removed from the field declaration. The field is now initialized with a null value, which is not a valid use case for Guice injection.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the `showBug` method on an instance of the `FinalFieldInjection` class, which attempts to inject a value into a final field. This is not allowed by Guice, as final fields are not visible to other threads.
